title: Salt mines and castles: The discovery and restitution of looted European art
subjects: World War, 1939-1945 -- Art and the war

The book is likely to appeal to readers interested in art history, World War II, and the intersection of cultural preservation amidst the ruins of conflict. As he travels from America to Europe, he is surrounded by fellow officers and iconic figures such as Charles Lindbergh, emphasizing the historical context.
